tickerText: [TENNIS] Rolex Paris Masters round of 16 Thursday on Court Central stacks three Frenchmen before Alcaraz–Berrettini and Fils–Fritz, after Wednesday shocks from Musetti over Zverev and Hijikata over Djokovic • [SQUASH] PSA Platinum U.S. Open quarterfinals continue Thursday at 6 p.m. in Philadelphia after Wednesday’s opening QF card at the Arlen Specter Center • [BADMINTON] Yeosu Korea Open Super 500 hits round of 16 Thursday at Jinnam Stadium as An Se Young chases an 11th title of 2026 after a 39-minute R32 win • [PICKLEBALL] Opendoor PPA Worlds shifts to round of 16 Thursday at Brookhaven with 11 a.m. CT first serve plus PPA Challenger pool play on PickleballTV • [TABLE TENNIS] WTT Champions Frankfurt Day 3 at Süwag Energie Arena opens the round of 16, including Liang–Calderano and home hope Dang Qiu after Harimoto and Wang Chuqin cleared the R32

newsItems.title: An Se Young to R16
newsItems.excerpt: World No. 1 An Se Young beat Kaloyana Nalbantova 21-6, 21-8 in 39 minutes and eyes a record-tying 11th title as Korea Open round-of-16 play opens Thursday in Yeosu.

newsItems.title: Worlds Round of 16
newsItems.excerpt: Brookhaven hosts PPA Worlds main-draw Thursday with round-of-16 matches from 11 a.m. CT as the 3,000-point major trims the pro fields ahead of Championship Sunday.

newsItems.title: Paris Last 16
newsItems.excerpt: Halys, Rinderknech and Van Assche head a French-heavy Thursday slate before Alcaraz–Berrettini and Fils–Fritz, following Wednesday upsets of Zverev, Medvedev and Djokovic.

newsItems.title: U.S. Open QF Night
newsItems.excerpt: Philadelphia’s PSA Platinum U.S. Open stages quarterfinals day two Thursday at 6 p.m. on the Specter Center show court after Wednesday’s opening quarterfinal session.
